commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak 37% and the Nifty retreating from the 25,500 resistance shelf, Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market timing rules demand strict defensive discipline. Despite massive institutional block flows sustaining select heavyweights, the general market is under distribution pressure. Under Mark Minervini's progressive exposure framework, this is not an environment for aggressive capital deployment. We restrict exposure exclusively to high-conviction Stage 2 leaders displaying verified CANSLIM earnings acceleration, flawless base construction, and low-cheat pivot setups. Laggards or decelerating earnings profiles must be kept on watch, while stop-loss thresholds must be honored rigorously without second-guessing.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AARTIPHARM.technical: Trading firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, confirming classic Stage 2 structure. A clean double bottom base has formed with RSI at 66, displaying healthy accumulation without momentum extension as price pushes toward the 1048.30 pivot trigger.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Operating leverage is firing across CDMO and Xanthine derivative segments. Operating margins expanded 441 bps YoY to 22.2%, supporting rapid bottom-line growth. Balanced debt levels and steady ROCE of ~11% align well with CANSLIM earnings criteria.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 963.18 swing stop, breaking the double-bottom support base.

ABDL.technical: Structure remains constructive above rising major averages. Price has etched a 14% deep rounded base with a tight 2.5% upper-half handle. MACD is positive above signal, pressing the 855.55 trigger, though volume confirmation on breakout is pending.
ABDL.fundamental: Volume expansion and premium whisky traction support revenue, but West Asia logistics and raw material inflation compressed margins. PAT growth of 9.7% lags sales growth, and a heavy ₹1650 crore capex keeps free cash flow constrained.
ABDL.risk: Pattern breaks down on a close below 795.67, invalidating the right-hand cup structure.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Displays premier relative strength, hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 1638.64 on powerful 2.33x volume surge. Alignment above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA satisfies Minervini's strict Trend Template criteria.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Phenomenal earnings power led by core transmission growth and smart-metering scale. Net profit more than doubled to ₹1,364 crore. High leverage (₹51,520 crore borrowings) is mitigated by regulated utility cash flows and a recent ₹3,500 crore QIP infusion.
ADANIENSOL.risk: Thesis invalidates below the 1553.47 support level; exit immediately to manage high-beta volatility.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Price holds above rising short and long-term moving averages with positive MACD divergence. A constructive double bottom base is carving out an entry pivot at 572.47, with strong candlestick recovery highlighting institutional demand.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Dominant national eye care franchise holding 26% market share. Operating profit rose 29% YoY with healthy operational cash flow and zero promoter pledge, though high valuation multiples (P/E ~97x) demand persistent execution.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Violation of the 529.94 swing pivot invalidates the base structure and necessitates strict loss mitigation.

AJAXENGG.technical: Strong 20-day breakout clearing previous resistance on an exceptional 16x volume expansion. Price trades above all key moving averages with bullish MACD trajectory, though extension from base requires disciplined entry execution at 620.52.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: Market-leading concrete equipment franchise with solid balance sheet and virtually zero net debt. Operating margins held at 10.6%, but topline growth slowed to 10.6%, missing the 15% CANSLIM threshold and reflecting broader construction equipment moderation.
AJAXENGG.risk: Reversal below 579.93 marks a failed breakout; discipline requires immediate liquidation.

ALICON.technical: Healthy Stage 2 double bottom base above all moving averages with RSI 71 confirming robust momentum. Approaching the 1019.02 neckline trigger, but elevated momentum indicators warrant caution against chasing before volume confirmation.
ALICON.fundamental: Record quarterly revenue of ₹652 crore fueled by domestic auto casting programs. However, aluminum cost inflation severely squeezed gross margins, pulling EBITDA margin down to 10.0% and causing EPS growth to decelerate sequentially.
ALICON.risk: Failure below 925.93 destroys base integrity and violates key moving average support.
